1.consolidated_definition: Al volquete se le conoce con el nombre de carreta de cajón en el este: Naranjito, Comerío, Caguas, Fajardo, Naguabo, Humacao, Maunabo, Vegas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: In the eastern region, particularly in Naranjito, Comerío, Caguas, Fajardo, Naguabo, Humacao, Maunabo, and Vega Baja, this vehicle is commonly referred to as a "carreta de cajón".
